senior-backend-engineer.summary: We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join our core team and build enterprise software platforms across Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
requirements: 4+ years of experience in backend development (Laravel / Node.js)
Strong database design skills (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
Experience building robust RESTful APIs & microservices architecture
Ability to work remotely during the 3-month evaluation period, then on-site in Maadi, Cairo

senior-frontend-engineer.title: Senior Frontend Engineer

requirements: 3+ years of experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript & TailwindCSS

Experience with modern state management & REST API integrations

Solid background in cloud security, monitoring & automated backups

meta.description: Albiruni's monthly uptime commitment, support channels and hours, response times, scheduled maintenance, backups and service credits.

availability.title: Monthly uptime
availability.text: We commit to keeping the system available at the rates below, measured monthly and excluding scheduled maintenance.

rows: 99.9% or as set in your contract

responseTimes.title: Response times
responseTimes.text: The time from receiving your ticket to the first reply from a specialist.

rows: High: a major feature is not working

maintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenance.text: We let you know at least 48 hours in advance, and we carry it out outside business hours whenever possible.

backup.title: Backups
backup.text: We back up your data every day and keep each backup for 30 days.

credits.title: Service credits
credits.text: If uptime falls below our commitment, you get a credit deducted from your next invoice:

exclusions.title: Exclusions
list: Internet or hardware outages on the customer's side.
Outages of third-party services, such as payment gateways and the government e-invoicing system.
Use that breaks the terms of service.

meta.title: Cancellation and refund policy
meta.description: How cancelling and refunds work for Albiruni subscriptions: the free trial, monthly and annual plans, plan changes, and how and when refunds are paid.

freeTrial.title: Free trial
freeTrial.text: The trial lasts 14 days at no cost, and we don't ask for a bank card. If you don't choose a plan, the account stops automatically, with no commitment.

monthly.title: Monthly subscription
list: You can cancel at any time from the settings or by contacting us.
Your account stays active until the end of the paid month.
There are no partial refunds for the current month.

annual.title: Annual subscription
list: Cancel within 14 days of payment: you get a full refund.
After 14 days: the subscription runs to the end of its term, with no refund.

planChange.title: Changing your plan
list: Upgrades apply immediately, and you pay only the price difference for the remaining days.
Downgrades start from the next billing period.

refundMethod.title: How and when we refund
refundMethod.text: We refund to the same payment method within 14 business days of approval. Payments made through Fawry, mobile wallets or bank transfer are refunded by bank transfer or to the wallet.

dataAfterCancel.title: Your data after cancellation
dataAfterCancel.text: We keep your data for 30 days after the subscription ends, and you can export all of it. After that, it is permanently deleted.

customProjects.title: Custom projects and services
customProjects.text: Custom development and implementation projects are governed by the contract you signed with us, which has its own cancellation terms.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: To request a cancellation or a refund, email <emailLink>{email}</emailLink> or message us on WhatsApp at <whatsappLink>{phone}</whatsappLink>.
